reasons: B builds most slogans on real Russian wordplay with the name, using the slang verb «батонить» (to laze about) in three of them, plus «база» slang and the double meaning of «мягкий подход». In A, only #1 (the twist on «бить баклуши») and arguably #2 (a nod to «спальный район») are puns, and the rest are plain descriptive taglines. A also has slightly stiff, calque-like «Батон: ...» colon constructions with capitalized continuations.
